description.name: Twin Element Mode (Water, Holy) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Water]/[Attach Holy] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Water/Holy)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Deluge (IV) (0~2), removed after using Deluge (IV) two times

description.name: Deluge (IV) Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Deluge (IV) level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Water/Holy)]

description.name: Deluge (IV) Level
description.text: Keeps track of Deluge (IV) level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Water/Holy)]

description.name: IV
description.text: Twenty single attacks (3.15/3.50 each) capped at 9999/19999, followed by one single attack (34.60/38.06) capped at 99999 at Deluge (IV) level 0/1, removes Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rydia (Water/Holy) from the user
